text:
The statutory period most likely began when the widow died in 1986, which replaces my earlier answer of one month later. Her death vested the cottage in the Boy Scouts, and the tenant's possession was then held against that owner, so the 20-year period would have run from 1986 and expired around 2006, before the 2009 discovery. The "subjective belief" option is the weaker choice, because adverse possession turns on objective hostility, not what the tenant privately believed.

CONFIDENCE: 55
